snippet.title: The Veil Express - Official Trailer
snippet.description:
ABOUT THE GAME:

The Veil Express is a cosy management game on a hidden magical train, where you build rooms and workshops for goblins, witches, fairies, ghosts and vampires. Players take their place as Conductor of the Veil Express: couple on carriages, attend to passengers' needs, and watch every room come alive in cross-section as the train rolls on.

The steam page + playable demo is coming out 28th October 2026 (next Wednesday)

Full game release in Early December 2026.

https://store.steampowered.com/app/5449540/The_Veil_Express/
